decisions.statement: Nothing here reads a path as a page.
A path with no body is written as an addition.
A path with another body is written over as a replace with the whole body each side.
A path already with the body given is left as that path is.
A body already there states no edit rather than a refusal.
A program folding many bodies together lands the bodies that moved.
Nothing here judges whether a body may be written.
A caller states under `old` the body that caller composed its body from.
A path holding a body other than `old` is refused rather than written over.
A caller stating no `old` writes over whatever body is there.
A path already holding the body given is left alone whatever `old` states.

definition: one body written at one path that does not have that body already
